design_options.name: guest_firewall_or_route_delete
design_options.reason: Guest-side policy is not a trusted boundary against compromised worker code or privileged guest actions.

design_options.name: host_pf_anchor
design_options.reason: Current evidence does not prove instance-scoped firewall targeting or rollback safety.

design_options.name: restricted_egress_proxy_only
design_options.reason: Proxy-only control cannot prevent direct IP/DNS/UDP bypass while direct egress exists.

design_options.name: lima_native_no_network
design_options.reason: No proven no-network knob exists in the current local Lima 2.2.0 artifacts and C5 observed default egress.

design_options.name: backend_replacement
design_options.reason: A backend with native no-network or enforced network namespace is architecturally cleaner.
